name: Too Late to Panic! Home V5.13-r7 — Rehber Aç/Kapa
body:
Critical tasks and first-wave guidance now use short cards in one narrow vertical column. The critical card shows brief tasks; first-wave guidance uses a short title, one sentence and the current action/location. Both start collapsed, and one shared guide button opens/closes them together. Run-end/penalty prose and the critical-card footer are removed. Passive F2 Dev Mod / F3 Skip Wave keycaps sit beside wave information; the selected-target menu is narrowed to 310 px. These labels do not add input handlers or change model/cost rules. Their visibility does not change actual task progress or gameplay clocks. The small object key bubble, normal fullscreen startup and removal of the duplicate lower-right action button are retained.

This is a narrow UI update from the published R6 package. The R6 release/tag/assets and source identity are preserved. Earlier R3/R5 superseded local-only records remain historical; R6 is never marked unpublished.

Windows64 portable ZIP. Extract fully and run TooLateToPanic.exe.
810 new Editor checks; 425 same-DLL native API/render checks and 14 reviewed captures; additionally 291 retained-presentation checks/12 captures and 10 normal fullscreen observations/1 capture. Shared regressions are not unique-test claims. All three chains bind this new DLL; previous R6 results are not transferred. Declared fixtures and API actions do not establish OS input or human play/readability/listening acceptance. Prerelease pending user playtest.

The shared guide toggle, short cards, removed footer/prose, passive F2/F3 keycaps, smaller selected-target menu, Turkish labels and checks used OpenAI Codex. No new external visual/model/shader/sound, provider credit or payment. Existing licenses/provenance and the concurrent local video are preserved. No competition form submission.
